description: Search arXiv papers by keyword — the equivalent of the search box and advanced search form on arxiv.org. The query accepts plain keywords or native arXiv syntax (ti:transformer, au:"lecun", boolean AND/OR/ANDNOT); optional parameters add advanced-search filters without hand-writing syntax: restrict to a field (title/author/abstract/comments/journal_ref/doi/paper_id/all), a category, and/or a submission-date range. Returns the total hit count plus paper cards (arXiv ID, title, authors, categories, date, abstract, abs/PDF links). Paginates internally up to the limit (max 200, one request takes the full limit; requests spaced ≥3s per arXiv API policy when paginating); partial=true when results run out. No authentication required.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search keywords (e.g. "vision transformer") or native arXiv syntax (e.g. "ti:transformer AND au:vaswani"). A plain multi-word query matches ALL words (AND) within the field chosen by --field; a query written in native syntax (contains a field prefix like ti:/au:/abs:/all: or a boolean AND/OR/ANDNOT) is passed through to the API verbatim and --field is ignored. Use quotes in native syntax for exact phrases, e.g. all:"vision transformer".

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Which field the plain keywords match — all 8 values: all = 全部字段 (all fields, default) / title = 标题 / author = 作者 / abstract = 摘要 / comments = 作者评论 (author comments) / journal_ref = 期刊引用 (journal reference) / doi = DOI / paper_id = 论文ID (arXiv ID). Mirrors the advanced search form's field dropdown. Ignored when the query is written in native syntax.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Restrict results to one arXiv category, e.g. "cs.AI", "cs.CV", "hep-th". Case-sensitive (subcategory suffix is uppercase, e.g. cs.AI not cs.ai). ~176 valid values exist — run arxiv/list-categories to enumerate them, or copy the ID from any category page URL (arxiv.org/list/{category}/new).

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Submission-date range start, format YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-01-01). May be used alone (only lower bound) or together with --date_to. Maps to submittedDate:[...] in the API.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Submission-date range end, format YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-03-31). May be used alone (only upper bound) or together with --date_from. Maps to submittedDate:[...] in the API.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Result ordering — all 3 values: relevance = 相关度 (best match) / submitted_date = 最新提交优先 (newest submissions first, default) / last_updated = 最近修订优先 (most recently revised first).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-200, default 50). A single API request fetches the full limit (no unnecessary pagination); partial=true when fewer results exist than requested.
